note_en: 分不清 "can't tell apart" is a potential complement: verb 分 "distinguish" + 不 + result 清 "clear." The text uses it again and again: 连小区保安都分不清谁是谁 "even the security guard couldn't tell who was who." Note the question word inside the object: 谁是谁 literally "who is who," works just like English, but Chinese can drop it into the sentence with no change in word order.
